defects: Hypothesis 'Antitone f' is global antitonicity on all of ℝ, strictly stronger than the gold's 'AntitoneOn f (Ici N)' which only requires monotonicity on the ray
Hypothesis 'hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x' requires nonnegativity everywhere on ℝ, strictly stronger than gold's nonneg only on Ioi N
Drops the general starting point N : ℕ entirely (implicitly fixes N = 0), losing the generality of the gold statement which applies to any eventually-antitone-from-N function
Summable hypothesis is 'Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ f n)' with no shift, whereas gold's is shifted 'Summable (fun n ↦ f (n + N : ℕ))' to align with the ray starting at N; only coincide when N = 0
Conclusion is IntegrableOn f (Ici 0) rather than IntegrableOn f (Ioi N), changing both the domain type (Ici vs Ioi) and hardcoding N = 0
